name: responsive-photo-gallery-monorepo
description: Workspace root: the gallery app, the enrichment service, and the shared in-tree packages. No application code lives here.

scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/config -w packages/path-safety -w packages/media-types -w packages/fast-image-processing -w gallery -w enrichment && npm run test --prefix gallery/frontend
scripts.dev:deps: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.deps.yml up -d rpg-redis rpg-meilisearch rpg-enrichment-indexer rpg-enrichment-worker
scripts.dev:api: IMAGE_PATH=./debug-data/pics CONFIG_PATH=./debug-data/config PRIVATE_KEY=nonvolatile CACHE_PATH=./debug-data/cache TAGS_PATH=./debug-data/tags ENRICH_URL=http://localhost:8080 PORT=8000 DEBUG=express,responsive-photo-gallery:* node --watch gallery/bin/www
scripts.dev: npm run dev:deps && (trap 'kill 0' INT; npm run dev:api & npm run dev:ui & wait)

overrides-comment: adm-zip: kludge for CVE-2026-39244 (crafted ZIP -> 4GB alloc). onnxruntime-node still pins adm-zip ^0.5.16 up through its latest (1.27.0), so no upgrade clears it. adm-zip is only used by onnxruntime-node's install-time CUDA-extract script (not runtime), and the 0.6.0 API we rely on (getEntry/extractEntryTo) is unchanged. Remove once onnxruntime-node relaxes the pin. sharp: force 0.35.x to clear the inherited libvips CVEs CVE-2026-33327/33328/35590/35591 (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj, fixed in libvips 8.18.3 bundled by sharp 0.35.0+). Our direct deps (enrichment, packages/fast-image-processing) already ask for ^0.35.3, but @huggingface/transformers' latest (4.2.0) still pins sharp ^0.34.5, so the override is what pulls the transitive copy forward. sharp 0.34->0.35 removed the deprecated failOnError/paletteBitDepth/sharpen props (none used here; we use failOn:'none') and requires Node >=20.9 (Docker is node:24). Remove once transformers accepts sharp 0.35.
